stories.title: Indorama Ventures highlights PET recycling capabilities
stories.summary: Indorama Ventures is showcasing its PET recycling technologies at the Sustainability Expo 2026 in Bangkok. The company aims to strengthen its position as global packaging regulations tighten and demand for sustainable materials rises. The exhibition demonstrates how used bottles are transformed into recycled raw materials and consumer products.

stories.title: UK considers recycling fee reform to reduce packaging
stories.summary: Environment minister Emma Hardy plans to reform business recycling fees to curb excessive packaging. Changes to Extended Producer Responsibility fees from April 2027 could save pubs up to 870 pounds annually by removing charges for glass bottle disposal. The initiative aims to address packaging that drives people around the bend.

stories.title: Telangana pollution board fines sweet manufacturers
stories.summary: The Telangana Pollution Control Board has fined three sweet manufacturing units 1 lakh rupees each for environmental violations. The board cited the use of prohibited single-use plastics, the discharge of untreated wastewater into public sewers and operating without mandatory environmental clearances following inspections of seven local units.

stories.title: Hyderabad sanitation drive results in 120 penalties
stories.summary: The GHMC has penalised 120 shop owners and street vendors a total of 1.29 lakh rupees for using banned single-use plastics. Officials seized 25.65 kg of plastic during a special sanitation drive that inspected 421 establishments. The commissioner also reviewed property tax collection and shelter home activities.

stories.title: Mumbai waste collection spikes during Diwali
stories.summary: The BMC collected 36,445 metric tonnes of waste during five days of Diwali, exceeding the average by 443 metric tonnes. The increase included firecracker remnants, gift boxes and packaging material. The civic body completed 6,787 transport trips to manage the surge in municipal solid waste.

stories.title: EU delays harmonised packaging labels
stories.summary: The European Commission has delayed the implementation of harmonised packaging labels under the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation until 2027. Full details regarding the policy shift are available to subscribers of Plastics News.

stories.title: India prohibits lithium-ion battery black mass exports
stories.summary: India has banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass to ensure the material is processed domestically. The Commerce Ministry issued the order to secure raw materials for local recyclers and refiners, aiming to reduce dependence on imported critical minerals like lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese.

stories.title: India bans export of battery recycled material
stories.summary: India has prohibited the export of recycled lithium-ion battery material. The government expects the measure to improve capacity utilisation for domestic recycling units and encourage further investment in the sector by ensuring feedstock availability for local refiners.

stories.title: India bans lithium-ion battery black mass exports
stories.summary: India has implemented a ban on the export of lithium-ion battery black mass. Further information regarding the regulatory change is available to subscribers of ET Auto. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.summary: India has prohibited the export of battery black mass to boost domestic recycling efforts. Further details regarding the government policy are available to subscribers of The Financial Express. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: India blocks battery waste exports
stories.summary: The government has changed the export policy for lithium-ion battery black mass from free to prohibited. The move under the Foreign Trade Policy 2023 aims to recover more lithium, nickel and cobalt at home. The Global Trade Research Initiative noted that India recorded no exports of the material.

stories.title: Plastic producers fined for recycled content failures
stories.summary: Plastic producers have been fined a combined 246,548 dollars for failing to meet recycled content requirements. Further details regarding the enforcement action are available to subscribers of My Edmonds News.

stories.title: Synthetic resin market navigates post-pandemic recalibration
stories.summary: The global synthetic resin market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement and a regionally diversified supply architecture. stories.title: Indian polymer prices decline
stories.summary: Indian polymer prices have declined across domestic markets. Additional details regarding the price shifts and regional industrial updates are available to subscribers of BigMint. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: India inflation hits two-year high
stories.summary: India's retail inflation reached 6.09 percent in October 2026, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's 6 percent upper tolerance limit. Rising food prices and increased costs across most consumption categories intensified household expenditure pressures, marking a significant increase from the 0.25 percent inflation recorded in October 2025.

stories.title: GAIL commissions PTA plant in Mangalore
stories.summary: GAIL has started a 1.25 million tonnes per annum PTA plant in Mangalore. The facility, formerly owned by JBF Petrochemicals, underwent a large-scale revival after GAIL took over the idle plant in 2023. The company described the commissioning as a milestone for its downstream petrochemical presence.

stories.title: Paper and paperboard prices remain stable
stories.summary: Paper and board prices in India have seen only minor changes over the past month. Geopolitical tensions continue to affect the market, with some distributors expressing concern over potential supply chain delays for imported papers. Prices remain indicative as actual transaction costs vary by purchase.

stories.summary: Vestolit is seeking company records from Dow as part of a multibillion-dollar ethylene pricing fight. Further details regarding the ongoing legal dispute are available to subscribers of Plastics News. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: GAIL launches 1.25 million-tonne PTA plant in Karnataka
stories.summary: GAIL subsidiary GMPL has commissioned a 1.25 million tonnes per annum purified terephthalic acid plant in Karnataka. The company says the facility will strengthen the domestic polyester value chain and reduce import reliance. The project follows GAIL's 2023 acquisition of JBF Petrochemicals through an insolvency resolution process.

stories.summary: A new IndexBox report suggests the global polypropylene compounds market is entering a transformative decade. The industry is moving toward more disciplined procurement and diversified supply chains. Polypropylene blends are increasingly used in automotive applications for their balance of lightweighting, durability, and cost efficiency.

stories.summary: A critical review of the European marine plastic value chain notes technological progress alongside persistent operational failures. Global recycling rates have remained stagnant at approximately 9 percent since 2019. stories.summary: Researchers have identified an enzyme in compost capable of breaking down polyurethane foam in laboratory tests. stories.title: Landfill test shows variance in biodegradable plastic
stories.summary: A study by KAIST and UNIST found that biodegradable plastics behave differently in oxygen-free landfills. PHB reached 99.9 percent mineralization in 17 days, while PLA reached 83.6 percent after 320 days. The results suggest that the term biodegradable does not guarantee consistent outcomes after disposal.
